exact_non_dp_lift.construction: two cubic graphs G_plus/G_minus on common edge set variables, induced by positive and negative clause occurrences
exact_non_dp_lift.theorem: F is SAT iff there exists T subseteq E such that T edge-covers G_plus and E\T edge-covers G_minus

poly_terminal_class.predicate: every clause C appears with its literal-wise complement not-C
poly_terminal_class.theorem: On exact Monotone 3-Sat-(2,2), U(F)=0 is the paired NAE special case proved always satisfiable in Doecker's work

open_obligation.missing: an exact polynomial transition that strictly decreases U(F) or another polynomial rank without branching, DP/resolution, or changing SAT semantics
open_obligation.warning: adding a missing complementary clause strengthens the formula and is not an exact transition
